assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single transparent PNG sprite atlas for a hand-painted fantasy strategy board game. Create ONE atlas, exactly FOUR equal columns and TWO equal rows (8 isolated building miniatures, one in each cell, row-major order). Wide 2:1 canvas, ideally 2048x1024. Every cell has generous empty padding; no part of a miniature may touch a neighboring cell or sheet edge. Genuine transparent background and alpha, NOT a checkerboard, white sheet, colored backdrop, terrain tile, or opaque island. No text, labels, numbers, borders, UI, characters, or tokens. Style: charming European storybook board-map gouache painting, slightly elevated three-quarter overhead view, readable compact silhouettes, warm ochre stone, weathered wood, muted terracotta roofs, visible fine brush texture, restrained fantasy detail. Soft daylight from upper-left, very subtle contact shadow directly below the feet; no long cast shadows, glow, thick outlines, or glossy 3D toy appearance. Objects should feel painted into a map at a small 45–80 pixel size, not monumental concept-art buildings. Tiny tufts or stones at the feet are welcome but NO broad ground patch. All 8 miniatures share identical viewpoint and coherent drawing scale. Terrain: golden farmland. Cell subjects in reading order: (1) small stone farmhouse with warm thatched roof and a little garden fence; (2) modest weathered red-roof timber barn and grain sacks; (3) slender wooden windmill with cream cloth sails; (4) compact hamlet of three small ochre cottages with terracotta roofs; (5) tiny rural chapel with a red pointed steeple, subtle magical fairytale feeling; (6) low stone astronomer's observatory with a blue copper roof and delicate brass instrument; (7) small open stone quarry entrance with timber hoist and mine cart; (8) low grass-covered barrow with a visible dark arched cave entrance and two pale standing stones. Keep all buildings modest and the palette warm and earthy. CRITICAL: exactly FOUR columns TWO rows. Each building is quite small within its cell, no greater than60% width orheight. Allcells have20% transparentpadding onallfour sides. Genuine transparent alpha channel, never paint a checkerboard. Choose subdued earthy natural pigments, no strong glow or shadows.
